metadata.case_name: CHAN WAI YAU AND ANOTHER v. HA HUNG YIU T/A SEE HING METAL WORKS FACTORY

plaintiff.occupation_before: operating a power press machine at the Defendant's factory
plaintiff.education_level: completed a course of training at school as an electrician

injuries.description: fractures of the phalangeal bones of the middle 3 fingers of the left hand
injuries.body_part: middle 3 fingers of the left hand
source: The Plaintiff had sustained skin lacerations, tendon lacerations, and fractures of the phalangeal bones of the middle 3 fingers of the left hand.

injuries.description: tendon lacerations of the middle 3 fingers of the left hand
injuries.body_part: middle 3 fingers of the left hand
source: The Plaintiff had sustained skin lacerations, tendon lacerations, and fractures of the phalangeal bones of the middle 3 fingers of the left hand.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia or tendon at wrist or hand level

injuries.description: skin lacerations of the middle 3 fingers of the left hand
injuries.body_part: middle 3 fingers of the left hand (palmar aspect)
source: The Plaintiff had sustained skin lacerations, tendon lacerations, and fractures of the phalangeal bones of the middle 3 fingers of the left hand.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple sites of hand

manifestations.description: scarring on the palmar aspect of the 3 fingers
lack of flexion in the 1st joint of the middle finger (joint always flexed at 20°)
similar lack of flexion in the ring finger
cannot make a full fist with his left hand
less dextrous compared with a normal worker
left hand is still painful and stiff at all times
pain suffered at the time of the accident, after his first operation, and during treatment and physiotherapy

treatments_received: subsequent operation to loosen the skin and tendons of his fingers

losses.description: Reduced dexterity of the left hand and inability to make a full fist.
Scarring on the palmar aspect of the three fingers.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Seldom plays basketball since the accident because of the effects of the injury.
Gave up work as a plumber because the injury interfered with his ability to do the work; risk of disadvantage in future manual employment.
